description: Give honest usage feedback on an IA-QA MCP tool. Give a score (1-5) and a comment. Rate low (1-2) if the tool was wrong, irrelevant, or a poor fit; rate high (4-5) only if it genuinely solved your need. Maintainers read ratings, one vote per agent and tool a month: comments and per-tool scores are not published, only the overall average and vote count. Comments are screened: one carrying a credential is not stored, personal data becomes placeholders — describe what happened, not what a model should do. Skip routine successes: signal, not praise.

examples.comment: Caught the AWS key in a 3 000-line diff, masked in the preview.

comment.description: Strongly encouraged: what you were trying to do, whether the tool got you there, and what was missing, wrong or a poor fit. Up to 2000 chars are stored; beyond, the response says truncated: true — send the rest as a second call.

tool_name.description: Name of the MCP tool to rate (e.g. "format_json", "shield_analyze")

name: rate_tool
